scope: Terminal admission/lifecycle verification and short native Mac observation at the stated sources; not release acceptance

verification.known_correctness_limit: baseline retains the three deliberately reproduced terminal failures; benchmark success is independent

private_bencher_upload.scope: eight source-verified baseline result files; private local credentials only

mac_resource_observation.scope: single short native GUI/daemon observation; owned idle sleep commands in a tiny project

method.rss: Darwin ps rss; summed child RSS is not unique physical memory
method.cpu: Darwin ps %cpu samples plus cumulative process CPU seconds; interval deltas use monotonic sample timestamps
method.threads: Darwin ps -M thread rows excluding header
method.descriptors: lsof numeric descriptors; excludes mapped files
method.disk: du -sk allocated bytes including SQLite WAL while running
method.transport: lsof TCP polling; short-lived sockets between samples can be missed

profile.method: Darwin sample; 5 seconds at 10 ms after resource samples

tcp_observation.method: lsof polling through window exit; short-lived sockets between samples may be missed

mac_ci_graphical.scope: native window, daemon connection, runtime inventory, running process discovery

scenarios: preview without writes and pinned initial installation
activation keeps the existing fixture daemon responsive
changed preview payload and active generation are refused
compatible rollback switches all commands and retains both releases
tampered executable is refused without changing activation
cleanup retains active, rollback and running or legacy binaries
uninstall preserves the live daemon and its state
daemon exit releases its pin and invalidates stale cleanup preview
unused payloads removed; permanent pins and daemon state retained

new_pty_original_failure.scope: real packaged CLI and daemon PTYs; no GUI input automation or provider integration

independent_cli_End_failure.scenario: actual CLI receives End while keyboard stays open

limits: One shared-runner baseline/corrected pair is advisory; backend timing does not establish GUI improvement.
The 100-agent observation uses idle owned sleep commands, not actual provider work or a soak.
Other desktop apps and development sessions were active on the Mac; window focus/occlusion was not recorded.
The original screenshot timeout and earlier higher GUI CPU reading remain unexplained.
The real PTY trial discovered separate daemon/CLI completion defects after the bounded GUI terminal unit tests passed; those fixes need their own source verification.
Private profiles, terminal bytes, discovered process state and raw logs are excluded.
